messages:
sofi: starting cross-GPU attention stress sweep across L40s / A100 / H100. seqs=64,128,256,512,1024,2048; bs=1,4,8,16. kernels: flash_v2, paged_fallback, hybrid_fused. using micro-gpt (8-layer encoder) and real-length distribution sampler. logs -> /mnt/bench/attn/2378014321
jack: nice. which sampling/profile config? any streaming or KV-warmup steps?
sofi: we warm for 20 iters, then 200 measured iters. command:
```
./bench_attn --model micro-gpt --devices l40s,a100,h100 --seqs 64,128,256,512,1024,2048 --bs 1,4,8,16 --kernels flash_v2,paged_fallback,hybrid_fused --warm 20 --iters 200 --profile flame --kv-stats csv
```
maria: please capture per-step KV hit/miss + memcpy type (async/sync) — last hybrid run had an unexpected cache flush.
bench-bot: KV trace enabled. KV CSV at /mnt/bench/attn/2378014321/kv_stats.csv; flames -> /mnt/bench/attn/2378014321/flames.zip; env dump -> /mnt/bench/attn/2378014321/env.txt
elaine: first L40s quick pass looks weird: flash_v2 @ seq512 bs16 = ~2.05 ms/token vs baseline ~1.4. did you toggle fused memcpy or MEMPOOL?
sofi: I forgot FUSED_MEMCPY and used small mempool. resubmitting high-batch configs with MEMPOOL=large and FUSED_MEMCPY=1. Will re-run 512/16 first.
jack: also check CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and any SM-affinity pins. L40s default runtime lacked fused memcopy until a recent flag flip.
sofi: rerun complete. updated trimmed medians (ms per token):
L40s, seq=64, bs=1 -> flash_v2:0.19, paged_fallback:0.24, hybrid_fused:0.21
L40s, seq=128, bs=4 -> flash_v2:0.36, paged_fallback:0.50, hybrid_fused:0.32
L40s, seq=256, bs=8 -> flash_v2:0.65, paged_fallback:0.98, hybrid_fused:0.52
L40s, seq=512, bs=16 -> flash_v2:1.40, paged_fallback:2.18, hybrid_fused:1.08
L40s, seq=1024, bs=8 -> flash_v2:3.3, paged_fallback:5.5, hybrid_fused:2.0
A100, seq=512, bs=16 -> flash_v2:0.95, paged_fallback:1.55, hybrid_fused:0.82
H100, seq=2048, bs=4 -> flash_v2:2.0, paged_fallback:3.8, hybrid_fused:1.85
maria: summary: hybrid_fused consistently outperforms paged_fallback at high seq/bs by ~30-60%. flash_v2 is fastest when full-attn fits native mem. hybrid shows better KV-resilience.
jack: did you pull occupancy/warp-efficiency from Nsight or sampled flame traces? I want to see if hybrid reduces memory stalls at cost of math.
sofi: have flames. sample flame excerpts (H100, seq1024, bs8):
[flame] hybrid_fused: aten::matmul(58%) -> fused-attn-kernel(46%) -> memcpy_async(9%) -> other(3%)
[flame] paged_fallback: aten::matmul(42%) -> paged-attn-kernel(30%) -> memcpy_sync(24%) -> stall(4%)
sofi: KV CSV shows paged_fallback miss rate jumping at seq>=1024: miss_rate ~18% vs hybrid_fused ~4%. memcpy_sync dominates paged case.
elaine: regression check vs previous baseline (2367004444): hybrid improved tail latency everywhere but introduced ~3% throughput regression at tiny corner seq=64 bs=1 on A100. selector must be cautious.
sofi: confirmed. selector currently prefers hybrid for many configs; add explicit opt-out: if seq<=128 and bs==1 prefer flash_v2. I'll open a PR to kernel-selector.
maria: also filing infra request: surface KV hit/miss + memcpy type counters in Console. @infra-team can we expose those per-model?
infra-team: noted. can you add a ticket with sample CSV schema and desired retention? we'll scope dashboard plumbing.
jack: actionable: (1) selector PR to avoid hybrid on tiny seqs (2) autoswitch hint: if KV miss >10% recommend hybrid or reduce per-device cache window (3) add memcpy_async vs sync metric to kernel metrics.
sofi: created branch with selector patch and perf test. running overnight exhaustive bs sweep on H100. will upload artifacts and a short perf memo tomorrow.
bench-bot: archived artifacts -> /mnt/bench/attn/2378014321/{results.csv,flames.zip,kv_stats.csv,env.txt}. md5sums also attached.
maria: thanks. next steps: merge selector patch after CI verify, infra ticket for metrics, and schedule a gated rollout for hybrid for Dedicated customers.
sofi: agreed. closing thread and moving log bundle to /dropbox/perf/attn/2378014321. will ping when PRs are ready. :white_check_mark:
